name: Bob Foundation
introduction: Bob Foundation is a creative design group, established in 2002 by Mitsunori Asakura and Hiromi Asakura (Suzuki), both graduated from Central Saint Martins College of Art & Design. They communicate, share and explore their interests with people through art work, design, drawing, film, photography, text and anything else that present possibilities. They are continually dreaming, thinking and doing therefore their works are always on going. They organize daily needs and products brand DAILY BOB.
